seo.title: Carrd vs Dorik — Which Website Builder Should You Pick?
seo.meta_description: Compare Carrd and Dorik side-by-side to find the best builder for your project. See which platform wins for landing pages, multi-page sites, e-commerce, pricing

hero.headline: Carrd vs Dorik
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.winner_hint: Best for simple, fast landing pages
summary.best_for_a: Carrd is ideal for creators, freelancers, and startups who need a single-page site or landing page launched in minutes.
summary.best_for_b: Dorik is better for small businesses and teams that want a fuller multi-page site with more built-in features and integrations.
summary.quick_take: If you want a lightning-fast way to publish a single, beautiful landing page or link-in-bio site, Carrd is the cleaner, cheaper choice. If you need a more traditional website with multiple pages, built-in widgets, and stronger integrations, Dorik gives you more structure and features at the cost of a slight learning curve.

paragraphs: Both Carrd and Dorik let you build attractive sites without hiring a developer, but they target different needs. Carrd focuses on single-page sites and extreme simplicity; Dorik aims to replace basic website platforms with multi-page layouts and more built-in functionality.

This comparison breaks down the key differences—ease of use, customization, e-commerce, integrations, price, and real-world use cases—so you can pick the tool that best matches your project and budget.

data.headline: Choose Carrd for speed and simplicity, Dorik for multi-page features
data.summary: Carrd wins when your priority is speed, price, and an ultra-simple workflow for one-page sites. Dorik wins when you need multi-page support, more built-in components, and better integration options for a small-business site.

pros: Fast setup for single-page sites with an extremely intuitive editor
Very affordable—great free tier and inexpensive upgrades
cons: Limited to one-page layouts and relatively basic site features
Fewer native integrations and limited e-commerce options

pros: Supports multi-page sites with more built-in components and blocks
Stronger integration options and simple e-commerce support
cons: Slightly steeper learning curve than Carrd for newcomers
Advanced features and smoother workflows require higher tiers

tool_a: Great for landing pages, portfolios, and link-in-bio

Better suited for small business websites

items.question: Can I use a custom domain with Carrd or Dorik?
items.answer: Yes—both platforms let you connect custom domains on paid plans, making either tool suitable for professional sites.

items.question: Which platform is cheaper?
items.answer: Carrd is generally cheaper for single-page needs; Dorik’s pricing is slightly higher but gives more multi-page and feature value.

items.question: Can I sell products or accept payments?
items.answer: Dorik has more built-in e-commerce capabilities and payment integrations; Carrd can accept payments via embedded checkout solutions but lacks full native e-commerce.

items.question: Which one is better for SEO?
items.answer: Both offer basic SEO controls; Dorik provides additional features and integrations that can help larger sites manage SEO and analytics more effectively.

items.question: Can I export my site if I want to move?
items.answer: Export options are limited on both platforms; Dorik sometimes offers better export flexibility, but moving complex sites often requires manual migration.
